profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a very hard working and goal oriented young woman. The first female high school graduate of my family and first generation University student. I put myself through 2 years at Pacific University, and one year at Willamette University, working 2 to 3 jobs and participating in extra curricular activities for talent scholarships, in addition to merit scholarships. All the while maintaining a 3.2 cumulative GPA. In 2016, I left Willamette University for an offer of full time employment as a Junior Software Developer at a small medical billing and processing company in Portland, OR which was later acquired by Mitchell International.  I am consistently commended for my professionalism and ability to integrate with teams and projects, come up to speed swiftly, and adjust my approach reflexively to aid my team most effectively.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Maintaining and improving as lead developer on an enterprise construction project management platform's .NET desktop application. Working closely with other development teams cross platform to ensure smooth integrations and continued feature delivery.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description:
Full stack .NET development of medical bill review software using the Agile methodology. Worked in a small, geographically diverse team to quickly develop and maintain software solutions for a leading bill review technology innovations company. Work process included development of new code, revision of existing code and bugs, updates of third party applications and their effects on existing code, supporting and iterating on existing bill review software as the primary engineer for the system, while facilitating the merging of Qmedtrix bill review solutions into Mitchell International's specialty bill review product offerings as part of the Mitchell International acquisition of Qmedtrix Systems Inc.

Accomplishments:

* Supported Qmedtrix bill review application, kept everything maintained with full responsibility for the system as the sole engineer.
* Successfully migrated system from old servers to new Mitchell servers in Mitchell's Data Center.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Development of medical bill review software using the Agile methodology as part of a small, responsive team to quickly develop and maintain software solutions for medical bill review specializing in workers compensation. Work process included development of new code, revision of existing code and bugs, updates of third party applications and their effects on existing code, and supporting users as the main contact on one of the projects through full stack .NET development.

JUNIOR SOFTWARE DEVELOPER (July 2016 - November 2016)
* Became the primary developer on a high profile project that provided great value to the company because of its marketability. The project was previously created by another developer years prior and had a lot of issues which I fixed in a timely manner to get the application production ready on the Executive team's timeline.

SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT INTERN (June 2015 - July 2016)
* Designed and implemented an automated deployment process for internal applications using Octopus Deploy and a console application that I created to tailor the process to the company needs. I later expanded this to automate script deployment as well.
* Refactored a large application to utilize Entity Framework 6, learning about Entity Framework in the process.
